name: Wind Down (Daily Reflection)
description: Nightly reflection on the owner's day: what we worked on, what they were after and why, a theory ledger, bounded research, fixes for repeated corrections, and a short note with at most three questions for the morning.

payload.message: [Wind Down (Daily Reflection)] Execute the routine bundled with this job exactly as written; it was passed to you in full. Do the work directly in this isolated cron turn; do NOT spawn another agent. Write the run report the routine requires before finishing. Return only a short delta summary as your final response (max 8 lines).
